question: Round-005 C stays: the entry list on the left, the entry on the right. You said "C because it gives me potentially preview functionality like a story book!" How should the right pane preview a component? App header is the real library component. The other entries are fixture data with stand-ins. Click entries and examples, and try the toolbar and controls.

variants.label: Docs page
variants.changes: "Preview functionality" as one scrolling page: every example of the entry renders live, stacked, each with its title and width (column at 420px, or full). Rules and provenance follow. No toolbar.

variants.label: Canvas
variants.changes: "Like a story book": the list becomes a tree, entry then its examples. One example shows on a large canvas with a toolbar: Column 420 or Full width, light or dark for the canvas only, plain or muted background. A Docs tab holds rules and provenance.

variants.label: Canvas and controls
variants.changes: B, plus a Storybook controls panel under the canvas. For App header: page, current round, showRoundTier and an all answered switch. The canvas re-renders as you change them. An example sets the controls; clicking the header's own icons and arrows updates them.
